region.name: the Duskmere
region.blurb: Wheat fields and windmills in the west, misty bogs and wheat fields and windmills in the middle, and in the east the thundering crags of Highcombe.

towns.name: Crownhaven
towns.blurb: A walled city of bell towers and busy markets. The Queen's summer castle stands over it all.

mayor.name: Mayor Ivor
mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.avatar: white-haired, twinkling-eyed mayor with a neat white beard, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and a gold chain of office
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Crownhaven.
Crownhaven is the pride of the Duskmere, and we are glad to have you.

quest.title: A Basket of Kittens for Eldergrove
offer: Would you carry this basket of kittens to Lord Digby in Eldergrove? Our cat had kittens again, and I hear they have mice.
They pay their couriers well, I promise.
quest.reminder: Lord Digby in Eldergrove is waiting for the basket of kittens.
done: Kittens! Oh, look at them. The mice had better watch out.

shop.name: The Golden Sheaf

keeper.name: Sage
keeper.avatar: cheerful cook-turned-shopkeeper in a flour-dusted apron

lines: Best prices in Crownhaven! Well, the only prices in Crownhaven.

workshop.name: The Busy Anvil

keeper.name: Saffron
keeper.avatar: strong-armed smith in a leather apron, with soot on her nose and a hammer on her belt

lines: Mind the sparks, and put the tools back where you found them.

npcs.name: Nessa
npcs.avatar: freckled child with a wooden sword and a helmet three sizes too big
lines: When I grow up, I'm going to be a hero too!
Can I hold your sword? Just for a second? Please?

gives.line: Are you a real hero? Mum says heroes always carry healing draughts. Here, take one of mine!

npcs.name: Sergeant Oswin
npcs.avatar: grizzled town guard in a dented steel cap, leaning on a halberd
lines: Arms up, chin down, hit hard.
I can train you, for a few coins.

spots.name: the Old Well
spots.text: You haul up the old bucket. Tangled in the rope is a Rusty Key!

towns.name: Highcombe
towns.blurb: A hill town of flattened barns and giant footprints. Thunder rumbles day and night.

mayor.name: Countess Olwen
mayor.title: Countess
mayor.avatar: elegant countess with braided red hair, a sea-green robe, and a silver circlet
greeting: Mind your head! Oh, it's you. The Queen said you'd come.
Rumblebelly sleeps up on the crag and comes down every morning to stamp on something. Yesterday it was the bakery.

shop.name: The Last Candle

keeper.name: Rolf
keeper.avatar: kindly old shopkeeper in half-moon spectacles and a knitted waistcoat

lines: I'm staying till the end. Buy what you need; you'll need it.

workshop.name: The Cracked Anvil

keeper.name: Wendel
keeper.avatar: bearded woodworker with curls of shavings stuck to his jumper

lines: Everyone else has fled. The anvil's all yours.

npcs.name: Old Linnea
npcs.avatar: stooped grandmother in a knitted shawl, with a basket of eggs
lines: Rumblebelly? Terrible business. I've seen worse. Not much worse, mind.
The Giant's Needle, the Lodestone Belt and the Lullaby Horn. The old songs say you need all three.

npcs.name: Watchman Tam
npcs.avatar: exhausted young watchman in a battered helmet, holding a bucket
lines: I used to guard the gate. Then the giant sat on it.
When the ground shakes, run. When it stops shaking, run faster.

spots.name: the Ruined Hall
spots.text: In the rubble of the old hall you find a Greater Healing Draught, somehow unbroken.

towns.name: Cloverwick
towns.blurb: A farming village of haystacks, duck ponds and very proud pumpkin growers.

mayor.name: Reeve Quill
mayor.title: Reeve
mayor.avatar: white-haired, twinkling-eyed reeve with wild curly hair, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and a lapdog under one arm
greeting: A hero, in Cloverwick! Come in, come in, mind the step.
Try the bread. Everyone in Cloverwick bakes.

quest.title: A Bundle of Healing Herbs for Heronmarsh
offer: Would you carry this bundle of healing herbs to Baroness Lark in Heronmarsh? A fever has broken out there, and these herbs will cool it.
They pay their couriers well, I promise.
quest.reminder: Baroness Lark in Heronmarsh is waiting for the bundle of healing herbs.
done: Herbs from Cloverwick! Bless you. The sick will sleep easy tonight.

shop.name: The Busy Bee

keeper.name: Perry
keeper.avatar: quick-talking trader with curly hair and a ledger under one arm

lines: Fresh bread, fresh draughts, fresh advice. What'll it be?

workshop.name: Hugo's Workshop

keeper.name: Hugo
keeper.avatar: bearded woodworker with curls of shavings stuck to his jumper

lines: Anvil, cauldron, grindstone: use what you like. Pedal hard and it all goes faster!

npcs.name: Herbalist Posy
npcs.avatar: herbalist in a green apron, with bundles of drying herbs hanging from the belt
lines: Every potion is a little poem, if you know how to read it.
Lessons are cheap. Not knowing is expensive.
The Old Chest in Cloverwick is locked. Its key was lost in the Old Well in Crownhaven years ago.

npcs.name: Delphine
npcs.avatar: shepherd in a thick wool cloak, with a crook and a sheepdog at heel
lines: The wolves have been bold this year. Keep to the road.
Stingnettle poison makes a giant sleepy and slow.

spots.name: the Old Chest
spots.text: The Rusty Key turns with a screech. Inside the old chest: a Tome of Vigor!
spots.lockedText: A heavy chest sits in the corner, locked tight. The keyhole is caked with rust.

towns.name: Eldergrove
towns.blurb: Tree-houses joined by rope bridges, high above the forest floor.

mayor.name: Lord Digby
mayor.title: Lord
mayor.avatar: white-haired, twinkling-eyed lord with a bushy black beard, a mustard-yellow waistcoat, and a lapdog under one arm
greeting: A hero, in Eldergrove! Come in, come in, mind the step.

quest.title: Old Mother Spider
offer: Old Mother Spider has been prowling the road to Mistmere, frightening every traveller. The traders have stopped coming, and the market is empty.
Beat Old Mother Spider, and you'll have my thanks, and a reward besides.
quest.reminder: Old Mother Spider is still out on the road to Mistmere.
done: Old Mother Spider beaten? Then Eldergrove owes you a great deal.

shop.name: The Acorn & Arrow

keeper.name: Rowan
keeper.avatar: cheerful cook-turned-shopkeeper in a flour-dusted apron

lines: Bows, cloaks, and forest remedies. All handmade.

workshop.name: Beatrix's Woodshop

keeper.name: Beatrix
keeper.avatar: glassblower with goggles pushed up into her curls

lines: Bark, sap and elbow grease. Help yourself to the bench.

npcs.name: Rosalind the Slightly Singed
npcs.avatar: small, round wizard in a patchwork robe covered in singe marks, with spectacles on a chain
lines: Ooh, I could do wonders with you. New hair? New cloak?
Magic is cheap. Well, sixty gold. That is cheap, for magic.

npcs.name: Baker Rufus
npcs.avatar: round, rosy baker in a floury apron, with a tray of buns
lines: My pies are famous as far as Frostreach. Well, as far as the end of the street.
Fresh buns every morning, before the rooster is up.

spots.name: the Fairy Ring
spots.text: In the middle of the ring of mushrooms lies a purse of 15 gold. You hear tiny giggles.

towns.name: Frostreach
towns.blurb: Terraces of snowy roofs climb the mountainside, joined by steep, icy stairs.

mayor.name: Baroness Gwendolyn
mayor.title: Baroness
mayor.avatar: small, brisk baroness with dark curls, a plum-coloured cloak, and a silver circlet
greeting: A hero, in Frostreach! Come in, come in, mind the step.
Brr! Come in by the fire. It is cold here, but our hearts are warm.

quest.title: The Winter Wolf
offer: The Winter Wolf has been prowling the road to Silvergate, frightening every traveller. Even the bravest carters turn back.
Beat the Winter Wolf, and you'll have my thanks, and a reward besides.
quest.reminder: The Winter Wolf is still out on the road to Silvergate.
done: The Winter Wolf beaten? Then Frostreach owes you a great deal.

shop.name: The Snug Mitten

keeper.name: Gus
keeper.avatar: soot-faced armourer with a thick moustache and a hammer on his belt

lines: Furs, flasks, and frost-proof boots. Stay warm, friend.

workshop.name: The Warm Hearth

keeper.name: Osric
keeper.avatar: broad smith in a scorched leather apron, with forearms like hams

lines: The warmest room in town! Pedal and you'll soon forget the cold.

npcs.name: Old Violet
npcs.avatar: stooped grandmother in a knitted shawl, with a basket of eggs
lines: Eat something! You're all bones.
The Deep Delve in Silvergate sells silver ore.

npcs.name: Theobald
npcs.avatar: cheerful minstrel in a feathered cap, with a fiddle under one arm
lines: Every hero needs a ballad. Yours is coming along nicely.
The quickest road to Highcombe is the one from Frostreach.

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: a Traveler's Tonic.

towns.name: Mistmere
towns.blurb: A village of reed huts and boardwalks over the marsh. Everyone owns a punt.

mayor.name: Countess Edith
mayor.title: Countess
mayor.avatar: tall, thin countess with dark curls, a green velvet coat, and a wheat-sheaf brooch
greeting: Welcome to Mistmere, Hero! The Queen's messenger said you would come.
Forgive the smell; it is the bog.

quest.title: Old Croaker
offer: Old Croaker has been prowling the road to Heronmarsh, frightening every traveller. Even the bravest carters turn back.
Beat Old Croaker, and the Giant's Needle, which has hung in my hall for a hundred years, is yours.
quest.reminder: Old Croaker is still out on the road to Heronmarsh.
done: Old Croaker beaten? Then Mistmere owes you a great deal.
As promised: the Giant's Needle. May it serve you well against Rumblebelly.

shop.name: The Bubbling Pot

keeper.name: Bram
keeper.avatar: red-haired ex-sailor with a tattooed forearm and a gold earring

lines: Potions, poisons, er, remedies. Curios of every kind.

workshop.name: The Bubbling Cauldron

keeper.name: Hazel
keeper.avatar: glassblower with goggles pushed up into her curls

lines: The cauldron never stops bubbling. Put something good in it.

npcs.name: Pip
npcs.avatar: barefoot child with a net, muddy to the knees and grinning
lines: The bog is safe if you know where to step. I know where to step.
Yvaine in Heronmarsh has a carved tusk, and would give it to a hero.

npcs.name: Old Blair
npcs.avatar: bright-eyed village elder with a knobbly stick and a patchwork cloak
lines: I've seen eighty winters in Mistmere. This one feels different.
Old Mother Spider prowls the road between Eldergrove and Mistmere.

spots.name: the Old Boathouse
spots.text: Floating in the flooded boathouse: a Quickening Elixir!

towns.name: Heronmarsh
towns.blurb: A village of reed huts and boardwalks over the marsh. Everyone owns a punt.

mayor.name: Baroness Lark
mayor.title: Baroness
mayor.avatar: stout baroness with a long golden plait, a patched but proud coat, and spectacles on a ribbon
greeting: A hero, in Heronmarsh! Come in, come in, mind the step.
Forgive the smell; it is the bog.

quest.title: The Midsummer Bonfire
offer: Our midsummer bonfire won't light. The wood is too damp. A Fire Flask would do it!
The Golden Sheaf in Crownhaven sells Fire Flasks, I am told. Bring me one, please.
quest.reminder: Have you found a fire flask? The Golden Sheaf in Crownhaven sells Fire Flasks.
done: Now we'll have a bonfire to remember!
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: Otto's Curios

keeper.name: Otto
keeper.avatar: red-haired ex-sailor with a tattooed forearm and a gold earring

lines: Mind the jars. Some of them bite.

workshop.name: The Bog-Iron Forge

keeper.name: Quentin
keeper.avatar: broad smith in a scorched leather apron, with forearms like hams

lines: The cauldron never stops bubbling. Put something good in it.

npcs.name: Ranger Crispin
npcs.avatar: hooded ranger with a longbow and a scar across one cheek
lines: The wild wears you down, if you let it.
I can toughen you up, if you've the coin.
Old Croaker prowls the road between Mistmere and Heronmarsh.

npcs.name: Silas
npcs.avatar: lean ferry-keeper in a wide hat, leaning on a long pole
lines: I take anyone across. Except goblins. Goblins don't tip.
Mind the water. It's deeper than it looks, and colder.

npcs.name: Yvaine
npcs.avatar: small child with scabby knees and a pet frog in one pocket
lines: Have you ever fought a road bandit? What was it like?
Can I hold your sword? Just for a second? Please?

gives.line: So you're the Queen's hero! Take this carved tusk, then. They say the Lullaby Horn is made with one.

spots.name: the Frog Pond
spots.text: A very large frog is sitting on a Quickening Elixir. It lets you have it, eventually.

towns.name: Silvergate
towns.blurb: A town of goatherds and stonecutters, stacked up a steep and windy slope.

mayor.name: Reeve Robin
mayor.title: Reeve
mayor.avatar: stout reeve with wild curly hair, a patched but proud coat, and a very large hat
greeting: Welcome to Silvergate, Hero! The Queen's messenger said you would come.
Silvergate stands firm, and so do its people.

quest.title: A Cure for the Fever
offer: Our children are burning with a fever. A Frost Flask would cool them.
The Snug Mitten in Frostreach sells Frost Flasks, I am told. Bring me one, please.
quest.reminder: Have you found a frost flask? The Snug Mitten in Frostreach sells Frost Flasks.
done: The fever will break tonight. Thank you.
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: The Deep Delve

keeper.name: Fenella
keeper.avatar: broad-shouldered shopkeeper with rolled sleeves and a flour-dusted apron

lines: Steel for heroes. Only the best, and the best isn't cheap.

workshop.name: Arden's Forge

keeper.name: Arden
keeper.avatar: cheerful tinker with a tool belt full of odd little tools

lines: The best anvil this side of the mountains. Strike while it's hot!

npcs.name: Miner Aldous
npcs.avatar: stocky miner with a lamp on the helmet and coal on the nose
lines: Never whistle in a mine. It annoys the trolls.
The Busy Bee in Cloverwick sells a Lodestone Belt. It costs a fortune: 240 gold.

npcs.name: Guide Basil
npcs.avatar: wiry mountain guide with a coil of rope and wind-burned cheeks
lines: Watch your step. The mountain doesn't forgive.
The Deep Delve in Silvergate sells silver ore.

npcs.name: Old Ellis
npcs.avatar: bright-eyed village elder with a knobbly stick and a patchwork cloak
lines: I've seen eighty winters in Silvergate. This one feels different.
Yvaine in Heronmarsh has a carved tusk, and would give it to a hero.

npcs.name: Cole
npcs.avatar: shepherd in a thick wool cloak, with a crook and a sheepdog at heel
lines: The wind up here could blow the whiskers off a cat.
The Winter Wolf prowls the road between Frostreach and Silvergate.

spots.name: the Abandoned Mine
spots.text: In the dark of the old shaft your hand closes on a Traveler's Tonic.

enemies.name: Hill Ogre
enemies.taunt: An ogre sits in the road eating a whole cabbage. It wipes its mouth and stands up.

enemies.name: Stone Troll
enemies.taunt: A troll steps out from behind a boulder. No, wait: the boulder IS the troll.

enemies.name: Wild Boar
enemies.taunt: A boar paws the ground and snorts.

enemies.name: Goblin Scout
enemies.taunt: A goblin cackles and waves a rusty knife.

enemies.name: Grey Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf slinks out of the grass, teeth bared.

enemies.name: Angry Swan
enemies.taunt: A swan spreads its wings and hisses like a kettle. It wants the whole road to itself.

enemies.name: Brown Bear
enemies.taunt: A bear rears up on its hind legs. It smells of honey and bad temper.

enemies.name: Bog Lurker
enemies.taunt: Something scaly rises from the muck.

enemies.name: Marsh Wisp
enemies.taunt: A pale light drifts closer, whispering your name.

enemies.name: Giant Toad
enemies.taunt: A toad the size of a barrel blinks at you, then flicks out a very long tongue.

enemies.name: Frost Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf as white as the snowfield pads closer, its breath freezing in the air.

enemies.name: Frost Sprite
enemies.taunt: A shivering sprite hurls a snowball. It is mostly ice.

enemies.name: Old Croaker
enemies.taunt: Old Croaker, the biggest toad in the bog, blinks slowly and puffs up like a drum.
enemies.avatar: toad as big as a haycart, warty and green, with a crown-shaped golden spot on its head

enemies.name: Old Mother Spider
enemies.taunt: Old Mother Spider lowers herself from the treetops on a rope of silk. Her eight eyes glitter.
enemies.avatar: spider as big as a cart, with grey-striped legs and a crown of cobwebs

enemies.name: the Winter Wolf
enemies.taunt: The Winter Wolf howls, and the air around you freezes.
enemies.avatar: pale blue wolf with icicle fangs and breath that freezes the air

enemies.name: Old Rumblebelly
enemies.taunt: "FEE, FI, FO... oh, never mind. I'll just squash you."
enemies.avatar: enormous grey giant wearing a barn roof as a hat, with lightning crackling in both fists

hints.text: Countess Edith of Mistmere keeps the Giant's Needle, and has promised it to whoever defeats Old Croaker.
Old Croaker prowls the road between Mistmere and Heronmarsh.
The Busy Bee in Cloverwick sells a Lodestone Belt. It costs a fortune: 240 gold.
Only a Lodestone Belt can turn Rumblebelly's lightning. The Busy Bee in Cloverwick has one.
The Lullaby Horn can't be bought or found: it has to be made, at the workshop in any town, from a carved tusk bound with two lumps of silver ore. It takes a few minutes of hard pedaling.
The Deep Delve in Silvergate sells silver ore.
Yvaine in Heronmarsh has a carved tusk, and would give it to a hero.
Old Mother Spider prowls the road between Eldergrove and Mistmere.
The Winter Wolf prowls the road between Frostreach and Silvergate.
The Old Chest in Cloverwick is locked. Its key was lost in the Old Well in Crownhaven years ago.
To defeat Rumblebelly you need the Giant's Needle, the Lodestone Belt and the Lullaby Horn.
Stingnettle poison makes a giant sleepy and slow.
The quickest road to Highcombe is the one from Frostreach.

challenge.title: Thunder over Highcombe
summons: Hero, thank you for coming so swiftly. Grave news has reached the throne.
Old Rumblebelly has come down from the mountains to Highcombe. The giant stamps on barns for fun, and thunderstorms follow wherever it goes.
The old songs name three things that can defeat Rumblebelly: the Giant's Needle, a Lodestone Belt to ground its lightning, and the Lullaby Horn, which sends giants to sleep.
Find all three, then face Rumblebelly at the Cloud Crag. Ask everyone you meet; the people of the Duskmere know more than they think.
Take this purse and these draughts. My carriage will carry you to Crownhaven. Everwyn is counting on you.

lair.name: the Cloud Crag
lair.text: A crag so high its top is lost in thunderclouds. The ground shakes with every step up there.

victory: You blow the Lullaby Horn. Rumblebelly gives a yawn as wide as a barn door.
One jab of the Giant's Needle, and down the giant goes, fast asleep, with a thud that shakes the hills.
The people of Highcombe tie up the snoring giant with every rope in town, then roll it home to the mountains.
